questions.question: Through the prophet Amos, what did the LORD promise to do with the fallen tent of David?

answers.text: Rebuild it like it was long ago
Leave it in ruins as a warning
Tear down what is left of it

questions.question: The LORD promised to rebuild David's fallen tent so that His people could possess what?

answers.text: Edom's remnant and the nations bearing His name
Philistia's cities and the whole land of Moab
Egypt's fields and the faraway land of Cush

questions.question: The LORD promised to bring Israel back from captivity. What would they do with the ruined cities they rebuilt?
The LORD promised to firmly plant Israel in their own land. What did He say about them staying there?

answers.text: They will never again be uprooted
They will be uprooted once more
They will move on to a new land
